title: How to Add a Video in a Sidebar | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content:
How to Add a Video in a Sidebar Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000033973 This article describes the steps necessary for adding a video to any website sidebar. For this example, the site is a Real Estate/Property site, and the video we will add is of a house. The video we are adding is to promote a new house, recently put on the market. This can be used to sell promotional ad space for existing profiles and external companies. Results: Step 1 - Create A New Widget: In the HTML tab, add the EMBED code for the video below the "
":
INSERT EMBED CODE HERE
It is also possible to add text and links to the sidebar:

New Property on the Market - Sold by John Doe

Additional Information: » Toolbox » Widget Manager Step 2 - Find the Sidebar to Display the New Video Widget Go to Toolbox » Sidebar Manager » Select the Sidebar, click Edit or Customize : For this example, we are using the Posts Search Result Sidebar. Inside the Sidebar, find the name of the new widget and drag-and-drop the widget: Now click on Save Changes . External Resources: » CSS Margin » HTML YouTube Videos For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
